name: omp-2-dsh
description: Out-of-tree DeepSeek Harness plugin suite (omp ports): worker-spawn, tree-engine, compact-mode, tool-read-write, advisor, channel-wechat, mode-ui, plus release/profile/doc tooling.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin/dsh-util run build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin/dsh-worker-spawn run build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin/tree-engine run build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin/dsh-compact-mode run build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin/dsh-tool-read-write run build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin/dsh-advisor run build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin/dsh-channel-wechat run build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin/dsh-mode-ui run build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin/dsh-review-gate run build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin/dsh-question-board run build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin/dsh-rules run build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin/dsh-peers run build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin/dsh-org run build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin/dsh-task-board run build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin/dsh-orchestrator run build
